INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has already been used.
PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: The payment amount does not match the permit price.
EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email address — we sent you a link.
TOKEN_EXPIRED: The link has expired. Request a new one.
FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
EMAIL_TAKEN: An account with this email address already exists.
NIP_TAKEN: An organization with this NIP is already registered.
CLAIM_ALREADY_PENDING: A claim for this water is already being reviewed.
WATER_ALREADY_CONNECTED: This water is already connected by another organization.
CLAIM_NOT_PENDING: This claim has already been reviewed.
PERMIT_TYPE_IN_USE: Permits of this type have already been sold: its terms cannot be changed and it cannot be deleted. Suspend sales or create a new type.
RULE_ALREADY_EXISTS: This species already has a general rule. Edit the existing rule.
EXTERNAL_PERMIT_IN_USE: Catches are recorded on this permit, so it cannot be deleted. You can correct its details.
PERMIT_START_IN_PAST: The permit start date cannot be in the past.
DISCOUNT_NOT_ELIGIBLE: You are not eligible for this discount.
PERMIT_TYPE_INACTIVE: This permit type is no longer on sale.
EDIT_WINDOW_CLOSED: The time to change this entry has passed.
RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
INTERNAL_ERROR: A server error occurred. Try again later.
NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
PERMIT_NOT_VALID: This permit is neither valid nor scheduled, so it has no QR code or PDF.
INVITATION_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation is for a different email address than the account you are logged in to.
INVITATION_EXPIRED: The invitation has expired. Ask the organization for a new one.
ALREADY_MEMBER: This person already has this role in the organization.
LAST_ORG_ADMIN: The organization must have at least one administrator. Give this role to someone else first.
TOO_MANY_PENDING_PAYMENTS: You have too many unpaid purchases. Finish an open payment or wait until an unfinished payment expires (about half an hour), then try again.
WATER_IN_USE: This water cannot be deleted: it is published or has claims, permits or catches linked to it.
